scope: Read-only renderer source audit, actual built-in synthetic self-test, and independent synthetic authentication/forbidden-call probes. No G market outputs were read.

checks.name: Complete receipt and source authentication
checks.evidence: Explicit full validation SHA is required. Prepared/validation status, config, source pins, original fixed population/gates/costs, and frozen F provenance are checked. Every referenced source/artifact is hashed before table/feature parsing and rechecked after rendering.

checks.name: Immutable original V1 and F lineage
checks.evidence: Original V1 recall/trade/event hashes are fixed and independently authenticated. F prepared and validation hashes are fixed. G labels must match frozen F bytes. Original V1 statistics are explicitly historical and retain their own historical random controls.

checks.name: No detector or economic rerun
checks.evidence: Renderer imports no yoyo detector, signal engine, simulator or scorer and calls none. It draws stored features/states/events and copies saved summaries; Holm7 arithmetic is verified from stored raw p values, not recomputed by a new statistical test.

checks.name: Stored parent and child event clocks
checks.evidence: Charts check state index/close clocks against source, verify published prices and actual parent age0..3 identity, and require saved markers to equal stored state events. Same-bar and delayed children are drawn as triangles at their own stored close time and close price, without relocating confirmation to the parent.

checks.name: Fixed global case selection
checks.evidence: HYPE/NEAR/PEPE have a fixed complete96-hour opening-bar window Aug18-Aug21. The axis uses actual Beijing close times; 8/19 22:00 and23:00 opening bars correspond to23:00 and8/20 00:00 closing lines. Both arms, original V1, six MAs, IMACD dual lines/zero and volume are shown.

checks.name: Rearm provenance is not a backdated signal
checks.evidence: Past shading uses stored prior12 source support [i-12,i), while a separate line marks when restoration became known at actual close i. Legend/text calls it provenance and qualification, not an earlier trade signal.

checks.name: Fixed denominator and economic interpretation
checks.evidence: Renderer verifies original1660/947/1463 denominators, parent/child/same-bar union counts, stored acceptance thresholds, and A-F+G Holm7. Economics remain accepted early-parent next-open paths, not saved V4 confirmation entries, and not account NAV.

checks.name: Unknown density remains separate
checks.evidence: Authenticated rearm_summary table is preserved verbatim, including unknown raw-edge, unknown asset-hour and unknown∩postdecision-locked hour fields. No held/ownership coverage or unknown count is credited to fresh retention. Final narrative must explicitly report these separate counts.

checks.name: Formal renderer lifecycle
checks.evidence: Exact builder bytes must match HEAD before formal build. Existing started/fragment/manifest/case/figure paths refuse overwrite. Sources and builder are rechecked before final report manifest.

self_test.output: Synthetic renderer checks passed: Holm7, missing-arm rejection, unknowns, 96 bars, same-bar/late child clocks, rearm provenance, SHA tamper and overwrite guards. No market inputs read.

independent_probe.fixtures: Only temporary generated text/JSON byte fixtures. No original historical market CSV/pickle or G result files were opened.

observations.text: The renderer preserves density_unknown_* values in tables but does not itself add an explicit unknown-density sentence to risks_and_honesty. The final MD should state their actual values, and must not describe data-insufficiency suppression as removal of false starts. This does not require any change to the frozen detector or acceptance gates.

limitations: This is a preflight audit. Actual G validation SHA, live market-derived counts, case outputs and charts await completion and authenticated formal rendering.
Synthetic rendering was exercised by self-test, but no actual G market chart was visually inspected here.
Subsequent prices in the fixed96-bar charts are retrospective context only; this renderer does not establish causal forecasting success.
No native Pine compile/parity or online changes occurred.
next_allowed_action: Root can commit this exact renderer and review receipt, wait for the independently completed G evaluation, then pass its full validation SHA to formal rendering. The renderer itself refuses premature, mismatched or repeated output.
